mask.operator: Convert mask to NESTED and lift exactly by repeating each parent value (2048/16)^2=16384 times. Scalar binary mask on native QU; then convert masked QU to RING for spin transform.

beam_and_response.nominal_resolution: Released 5 arcmin products; observed nominal map resolution is supported by PR4 usage documentation, simulation suffix 005a by release resolution convention and official catalog. Exact anisotropic response is the delivered Commander/NPIPE pipeline, not this Gaussian descriptor. FITS probes contain no FWHM card; do not claim header-measured beam.
beam_and_response.treatment: Use delivered maps without additional smoothing, beam/pixel deconvolution, noise rescaling, inpainting or scalar transfer correction. Same post-release operator for observed and simulated maps. Low-ell suppression and anisotropic processing remain in the released null.
beam_and_response.limitation: No all-m upstream transfer matrix is reconstructed. This is a processed-map conditional morphology law, not deconvolved cosmic E inference. A contradictory product/header/version finding must return for scientific interpretation before mixing products.

operator.metric_convention: (-,+,+,+); c retained explicitly when relevant; no velocity, stress or dynamical conversion is used here
operator.map_stage: Read named QU fields and flatten their vector columns in HEALPix pixel order; reject header disagreement. Convert to float64 K_CMB. Apply frozen mask at native NSIDE2048, explicit NESTED-to-RING. No I/T map enters.
operator.harmonics: healpy.map2alm_spin([masked_Q,masked_U], spin=2, lmax=4, mmax=4), record healpy/libsharp versions. Preserve E and B packed coefficients and full signed-m E for ell=2,3,4 with a(l,-m)=(-1)^m conjugate(a(l,m)). Use the existing COSMO healpy convention without an unexplained U or E sign flip.
operator.statistic: For each ell, normalize E coefficients by sqrt(sum_m abs(a_lm)^2). J234 = Im sum_{m+n+p=0} Wigner3j(2,3,4;m,n,p) v_2m v_3n v_4p. Primary T=abs(J234), with signed J also retained.
operator.reuse: docs/research_program/observational_publication_20261015/ADVERSARIAL_AUDIT_20261022/continuation/cmb_counterpairs/morphology.py :: normalized, contraction, features ONLY; do not run its old main or use its joint_score
operator.scan: Exactly one Commander FULL product, one fixed mask, ell triple (2,3,4), E field, abs(J234). No parameter fitting, rotation search, pipeline selection, extra-mask scan or combination with 030 is in primary T.
operator.secondary: Retain C_ell and axis alignment23_squared as descriptive outputs without a second calibrated significance claim. Axis degeneracy is ABSTAIN for alignment only, not rejection of a finite valid J.
operator.invalids: Require finite unmasked QU and finite nonzero ell norms. Explicitly set excluded pixels to zero rather than multiply NaN by zero. Record bad/missing products; do not substitute zeros, skip unfavorable MC draws or silently alter the mask. Resume acquisition/repair for the same IDs. Unexpected physical/source invalidity returns to science owner.

working_null.law: One public NPIPE/Commander end-to-end processed FULL CMB estimate per distinct MC ID, with its original joint sky, noise and processing. The published construction uses FFP10 CMB, fixed foreground/instrument settings and Commander mixing matrices estimated from the observed data, with amplitudes fitted per simulation.
working_null.interpretation: Conditional plug-in released-pipeline working law. Fixed observed mixing matrices are not a proof of unconditional coverage or the exact conditional distribution given their estimated values. Finite-MC interval covers only simulation tail uncertainty under independent realizations of this law.
working_null.exchangeability: The plus-one rank is a conditional Monte Carlo reference under the explicitly assumed observed/simulated exchangeability of this working model. Do not assert guaranteed physical false-positive control or robustness to unrepresented foreground/calibration uncertainty.
working_null.unit: One parent sky/iteration is one null unit. A/B/full, repeated masks, and split products never increase B.
working_null.no_reconstruction: Do not manufacture processed totals from cached symmetric-beam raw CMB plus regressed residual. No foreground, transfer or cross-block is added independently. No extra empirical noise alignment is inferred from a filename.

mc_plan.pilot_role: Eight sequential products test source handling, common operator, invalid branches and streaming accounting. Pilot is not the final precision target; keep all pilot outcomes.
mc_plan.accuracy_target: 95% two-sided Clopper-Pearson interval for the tail probability with half its width <=0.105; N=100 guarantees approximately this coarse worst-case precision. Report actual interval. This is an accuracy target, not a resource/one-use allowance or detection threshold.
mc_plan.rank: k=count(T_b>=T_obs), ties inclusive; p_rank=(1+k)/(B+1); minimum at B=100 is 1/101. Also report k, B, k/B.
mc_plan.mc_interval: For k out of B, lower=0 if k=0 else BetaQuantile(0.025;k,B-k+1); upper=1 if k=B else BetaQuantile(0.975;k+1,B-k). Interval is for the underlying conditional tail probability, not plus-one pseudo-observations.
mc_plan.stopping: Complete fixed 0300-0399 regardless of intermediate tails. No early significance stopping. Acquisition failures remain explicitly incomplete/resumable and are not scientific exclusion criteria.
mc_plan.extension: If greater precision is later desired, a prospectively declared extension can use remaining catalog-qualified IDs (0400-0599,0700-0799), retaining all earlier draws/accounting. Do not claim an optional-stopping-safe combined interval without a new declared construction.
mc_plan.seed: No new random draws needed: public fixed MC IDs are the reproducible ensemble. Use fixed algebra control angles 0.41 and 0.37 radians; no random seed can certify released genealogy.

controls_and_tolerances.criterion: Full-file sizes, actual HDUs/fields/units/frame/COSMO/order match; mask binary,1273/3072 retained, NESTED parent-child lift exact. Record source SHA256 as downloaded; upstream unavailable hashes are UNKNOWN rather than invented.

Reuse existing normalized-reality and imaginary-Wigner checks at 1e-12. Post-extraction parity a_lm->(-1)^ell a_lm reverses J; z rotation a_lm->exp(-i*m*0.41)a_lm preserves J and powers within1e-12 normalized/relative. These are output-space controls, not rotated-sky-through-fixed-mask claims.

On a retained nonzero vector, positive unit rescaling leaves J within1e-12 and powers scale quadratically; transform of Q1+Q2 equals coefficient sum to relative norm1e-10. No tolerance is an empirical genealogy threshold.

On observed and pilot0300 compare retained ell<=4 coefficients from lmax4 versus lmax8, same map/mask and noniterated transform: relative joint E/B norm residual <=1e-10 (zero norm handled explicitly). This is floating-point consistency, not a physical response tolerance; record failure without retuning.

Generate three unit-norm real-field harmonic injections separately: E(ell2,m0); E(ell3,|m|1) with positive-m1/sqrt2; B(ell4,|m|2) with positive-m i/sqrt2 and reality-related negative m. Synthesize native NSIDE2048 QU in the same spin convention; apply identical mask+analysis. Save all output E/B ell2..4 coefficients as three response columns; demonstrate finite anisotropic coupling and E/B mixing where present, never require each off-diagonal to be nonzero. Verify masked-pixel QU is exactly zero and linear superposition relative norm<=1e-10. No full42x42 or NPIPE reprocessing is required.
Exercise bad header/unit, nonfinite retained pixel, zero ell, missing MC ID and axis-degenerate handling. Keep original failures. A valid J with degenerate descriptive axis remains valid.
